note.en: Kosdaq −18.05pt (−2.34%) to 753.23 on 29 Oct, back below the 764.10 of 22 Oct; foreigners net sold ₩130.4bn, institutions ₩75.9bn and individuals bought ₩217.3bn (EBN, 15:43 KST). KOSPI −74.78pt (−1.24%) to 5,937.66 after an intraday high of 6,100.11 and low of 5,817.92; foreigners bought ₩72.1bn, institutions sold ₩444.7bn, individuals bought ₩34.3bn (EBN). Samsung Electronics −4.13%, SK hynix +2.62%, LG Energy Solution −8.60%; on the Kosdaq Rainbow Robotics −6.55% and EcoPro −4.43%. USD/KRW 1,336.30 at 15:33 KST, won stronger by 7.20.

Signals lean negative: Kosdaq −2.34% and back below its 22 Oct close, foreigners net sellers for a second session, Brent near $116, a US tech selloff led by Alphabet, and a December hike still priced as of 28 Oct. The one offset is the 10-year par yield easing to 4.98%. The gate stays shut until rates ease further or foreign money returns to the Kosdaq.

read.en: Thursday undid part of Wednesday's chip surge: KOSPI gave back 1.24% to 5,937.66 after touching 6,100 intraday, and the Kosdaq fell 2.34% to 753.23, losing its 22 Oct close of 764.10 as foreigners sold ₩130.4bn while individuals absorbed ₩217.3bn. The trigger came from New York, where Alphabet's roughly 12.5% drop on negative free cash flow and heavy AI capex hit the AI trade and pulled the Nasdaq down 1.4%. The relief was in rates only: the 10-year par yield eased to 4.98% from 5.05%, but Brent is near $116 and the market still carries a December hike. A liquidity-first read keeps the Kosdaq bounce of 28 Oct in the category of rallies that foreign money did not confirm.
read.kr: 목요일 증시는 수요일 반도체발 급등분을 일부 반납했다. 코스피는 장중 6,100선을 터치한 뒤 1.24% 내린 5,937.66에 마감했고, 코스닥은 2.34% 하락한 753.23으로 10/22 종가(764.10)를 내줬다. 외국인이 1,304억 원을 팔고 개인이 2,173억 원을 받아냈다. 방아쇠는 뉴욕이었다. 알파벳이 마이너스 잉여현금흐름과 과도한 AI 설비투자 부담에 12.5% 가량 급락하며 AI 트레이드가 흔들렸고 나스닥은 1.4% 밀렸다. 금리만 숨통이 트였다. 10년물 par는 5.05%에서 4.98%로 내렸지만 Brent는 116달러 부근이고, 12월 인상 가능성은 시장에 남아 있다. 유동성 우선 관점에서 10/28 코스닥 반등은 외국인이 확인해주지 않은 반등으로 분류된다.
